_README: Frozen application profile for jobapply. Lives at ~/.config/jobapply/profile.json (chmod 600), outside any repo. Edit BY HAND ONLY, then run: python3 ~/jobapply/profile_check.py
_normalize: Question keys in `answers` are normalized as: lowercase -> replace every non [a-z0-9 ] char with a space -> collapse whitespace -> strip. The form filler normalizes the on-page label the same way before lookup. No match => human queue. Never guess.

education._note: [0] = the degree in progress. Its end date drives grad_year/grad_month on forms.

answers._WARNING: FROZEN CONSTANTS. Human-reviewed. NEVER model-inferred, NEVER regenerated per form, NEVER edited by an agent. A flipped work-authorization answer is a materially false statement on an employment application (grounds for a rescinded offer or termination). null or absent = the form goes to the human queue.
answers._bright_line: NEVER answer Yes to citizenship or permanent residency. A false claim to US citizenship is a federal crime (18 U.S.C. 911) and a permanent, generally unwaivable inadmissibility bar (INA 212(a)(6)(C)(ii)). This outranks any job.
answers._visa_dropdown_rule: Prefer option 'F-1 (OPT)' > 'F-1' > 'Requires sponsorship' > 'Other' + free text 'F-1 / post-completion OPT'. NEVER pick H-1B, Permanent Resident, Citizen, TN, or Green Card. A visa/work-auth EXPIRATION date question goes to the human queue.
answers._referral_source_note: The bare word 'Website' matches more dropdowns than 'Company website' (many only offer '<Company> Website').
answers._salary_note: Decide ONE figure (or 'Negotiable') yourself. null = every required salary field goes to the human queue, which is safe but slow.
answers._start_date_note: The start date printed on your OPT EAD, NOT your graduation date and not 'immediately'. Working before it is unauthorized employment. Use a best estimate (YYYY-MM-DD) until the EAD arrives, then reconcile.
answers._previously_applied_note: Not a constant -- it changes as this system applies. The filler answers it from the applications table, or routes to human if the DB has no answer.
answers._eeo_note: Voluntary EEO self-ID. Defaults to Decline everywhere; change only if you want to disclose. Hispanic/Latino is a different question from race -- never derive one from the other.
_eeo_option_aliases: I do not wish to answer
I do not want to answer
answers._willing_onsite_relocate_note: Willingness only ('willing to relocate/commute'). A label stating a present-tense residency FACT ('are you currently based near our office') is never answered from this key.
answers._data_processing_consent_note: Narrowly scoped to generic GDPR/CCPA-style 'consent to processing your personal data for assessing your candidacy'. Distinct from 'acknowledge'.
answers._personal_habit_note: A REAL personal fact you write once; reused verbatim. Never invented.
answers._privacy_ack_policy: Privacy-notice RECEIPT/ACKNOWLEDGMENT only. Does NOT extend to arbitration, class-action waivers, or any certification -- those use 'acknowledge' below.
answers._acknowledge_policy: Blanket 'agree to terms / arbitration / certification' checkbox. null = every such box goes to you. Set 'Yes' only if you decide to accept all of them unread.
answers._programming_languages_policy: Only languages that are on your resume (docs/master.md).

_MISSING.resume_pdf: Generated per-application by docs.py. Not blocking.

attachments._never_upload: Never attach an I-20, EAD, passport or any immigration document to a job application. No legitimate employer requires it pre-offer.

limits._auto_submit_note: Master switch. false = every application stops at a verified draft and needs `db.py claim <uid> --approved`. Flip to true only after ~20 drafts review clean. Tier-1 ignores it and always stops at a draft.
limits._note: daily_target caps submits/day in db.py claim(). Greenhouse spam flags are per-employer and permanent, so per_company_per_week matters more than the daily number.

accounts._: Portals where you ALREADY have a login. Nothing here is created by an agent: creating an account and typing a password are prohibited actions. Add a tenant yourself after signing up and verifying the email.
accounts._workday: Workday's account wall is per-EMPLOYER tenant (the <tenant> in <tenant>.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com). A tenant listed here is automatable; one not listed is route=manual.

fraud_tripwire._note: No legitimate US employer requires any of these PRE-OFFER. A form asking for one is a probable fake-recruiter scam (international students are specifically targeted). Abort, flag, notify the user. Never fill, never store.
